reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the fluorine surface treatment from γ-TiAl alloys (P1, P6) to Al-containing refractory high-entropy alloys, but the mechanism and expected outcome are taken almost verbatim from the TiAl literature without new mechanistic insight or justification for why it should work in the chemically and structurally distinct RHEA system. The core idea is essentially the proposed future work implied by the TiAl studies, applied to a different alloy class with only a generic link to RHEA oxidation studies (P2).
copied_elements: weight gain reduction compared to untreated alloy
mechanism of Al fluoride intermediates decomposing to Al2O3
application to Al-containing alloy for oxidation resistance
